meta.source: Station weighbridge exports supplied by the operator (per-weigh-in records).
meta.sourceZh: 由營運方提供的轉運站地磅記錄（逐次過磅）。

excluded.noteEn: Only 完成 (completed) weigh-ins are counted. Cancelled and rejected weigh-ins are excluded, as is the station's own maintenance-vehicle tonnage.
excluded.noteZh: 只計算「完成」的過磅記錄；「取消」及「拒絕」記錄，以及轉運站自身維護車的噸數，均不計入。
